confirmedIssues.detail: Selected vehicle drives reads/mutations, but this page exposes neither a selector nor target identity. /benchmarks disables the managed vehicle control, and desktop WorkspaceHeader conditions VehiclePicker on that control. URL/saved/first-fleet fallback may therefore determine an unseen target. This is source scope ambiguity, not observed unauthorized access.
confirmedIssues.fix: Make a route-specific workspace vehicle-control decision and render real target identity. Reuse the existing selector/store.

confirmedIssues.detail: Unknown/failed participation without retained data becomes optedIn=false. CohortEligibilityPanel receives this false and selects Consent required before participation is known. ConsentGate itself is protected by BenchmarkStatusContent; its loading opt-in button is not claimed visible.
confirmedIssues.fix: Keep unknown distinct from known false; pass existing status trust to the cohort explanation while preserving consent-dependent reads.

confirmedIssues.detail: Page merges GET-release and create-mutation errors into one prop; this callout labels either Could not create release. Cohort/chart also receive no release DataState, so failed initial reads can select local empty wording. Global named DataSourceNotice and comparison retained warnings exist; this is NOT absence of all retry/error feedback.
confirmedIssues.fix: Separate read/command errors and thread existing release DataState into affected sections, preserving retained values and source-specific initial/paused/fatal/empty/retry meaning.

confirmedIssues.detail: hasBudget checks finite inputs only. Present zero/negative allowance receives pct=0 and normal intent through UsageCard, converting an undefined ratio into measured zero use. Negative finite spent also passes. Missing inputs already omit the budget correctly.
confirmedIssues.fix: Validate denominator/domain at this display boundary; invalid ratios remain unknown/indeterminate. Preserve valid spent=0 with positive allowance, 70/90 thresholds and actual over-budget overflow.

confirmedIssues.snippet: action={{ label: t('benchmarks.cohort.create', 'Create release'), onClick: onCreate }}
confirmedIssues.detail: Initial Create release passes only onClick. EmptyState renders an enabled Button; createNow guards only vehicleId. Unlike the existing-release Button, this branch does not consume pending. Duplicate requests and backend idempotency were NOT exercised.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing Button pending/disabled presentation and a dispatch guard for initial create, preserving its explanation and stable source check; no shared EmptyState expansion needed.

confirmedIssues.detail: Acknowledgement is an unscoped boolean; PrivacyControls holds an unscoped open dialog whose current callback dispatches the current vehicleId. SafeRoute keys only pathname, not query-only vehicle changes. Neither acknowledgement nor typed confirmation captures target identity. No wrong-target mutation was run.
confirmedIssues.fix: Bind acknowledgement/confirmation authority to the captured real vehicle; invalidate stale authority on scope change without retargeting a submitted/confirmed action or misrepresenting server outcomes.

confirmedIssues.detail: onConfirm calls void onRevoke and immediately closes before the mutation settles. loading={pending} cannot retain the confirmed dialog attempt during settlement/rejection. The outside error callout remains; no fake success toast is alleged.
confirmedIssues.fix: Await actual revoke settlement, close/reset only on current-target success, and retain failure context/recovery using existing mutateAsync/dialog owners.

confirmedIssues.detail: created_at is interpolated directly into visible Released {{date}} freshness/provenance, bypassing the preference-aware date hook. Period boundaries are also raw; calendar-versus-instant semantics must not be guessed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing preference-aware release timestamp display; preserve raw instant and independent completed-period calendar meaning.

confirmedIssues.detail: Tooltip uses String(value). The percentile data column also lacks kind/formatter; ChartContainer consequently selects String(raw). User-facing values bypass effective locale/precision though comparison details use preferences.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use useNumberFormatting for tooltip/accessibility column display; retain raw numeric data/export scope and 0-100 scale.

confirmedIssues.detail: Bar receives no motion-aware animation props. The chart barrel directly re-exports vendor Bar; chartDefaults requires chartAnimationProps for such series. Page FadeIn governs its own entrance, not this series. Actual OS/low-bandwidth behavior NOTRUN.
confirmedIssues.fix: Apply existing chartAnimationProps/useMotionPreference contract at this Bar, without changing data/identity/export/table.
